name: Shimano seven-speed cassette (I group)
weight_description: Weight withheld because manufacturer references conflict for the same seven-speed I-group 13–23T sprockets and spacers: the 1990 600 Ultegra table gives 286 g, while the 1991 Deore XT table gives 325 g. No distinguishing weighed variant is identified; neither value is used as the canonical weight.
